integrity: The published local estimator, three-way step-size rule, inertial recurrence, and admissibility condition were inspected directly in the open full text. The limit and sharp parameter envelope are derived analytically; the bundled computation only replays representative cases.
scientific_limitations: The exact limit is for the scalar positive quadratic on tails without consecutive-repeat events, because the source sets its local curvature estimate to zero on a repeat. The result concerns the adaptive step-size mechanism and is not a lower bound on the full accelerated convergence rate.
title: Sharp asymptotic curvature-use ceiling in Wang--Peypouquet adaptive acceleration
